episode_title: 509. What's Your Restaurant Really Worth: How to Build Value Before You Sell - Robin Gagnon

real_qa.q: What financial documents does a restaurant owner need to prepare before selling through WeSellRestaurants.com?
real_qa.r: Make sure your CPA is your best friend and your numbers are tied down. You need profit and loss statements, clean of any owner expenses, representing what a new owner can get from the business, referred to as owner benefits or seller's discretionary earnings. P&Ls should be done at least quarterly, if not monthly.

real_qa.q: How long does it typically take to sell a restaurant and what is the average days on market?
real_qa.r: The average days on market for a restaurant right now is around 190 days. This is calculated from the day you sign the listing agreement until the day money comes in at the closing table. You should expect to sign a listing agreement for a year and expect it to take three to six months to attract the buyer.

real_qa.q: What are the most common mistakes restaurant sellers make that cost them money in the sale process?
real_qa.r: One of the biggest mistakes is paying employees off the books, which misrepresents labor costs. Buyers are sophisticated and use AI to verify realistic margins. If you're doing this, you need a two to three year window before selling to bring those expenses onto the books. Another mistake is deferred maintenance like a piece of tape on a cooler or failing to maintain HVAC systems.

real_qa.q: How should restaurant owners use AI to increase their restaurant's value before sale?
real_qa.r: Take all your institutional legacy knowledge and dump it into AI to build recipes, tell how many people it feeds, so someone coming in could read this and execute against the business model. Get out of your head what you know so a new owner doesn't require your presence on site.
real_qa.requete: AI systemize restaurant documentation buyer training

real_qa.q: What is the difference between selling a restaurant with real estate versus without, and which is more common?
real_qa.r: Approximately 75 to 80 percent of restaurants sell without the real estate. When you own the real estate, your building can become worth more than the cash flow your business can support.
